headword: {海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}
reading: かいじょうじえいたい

definitions.explanation: The naval branch of Japan's Self-Defense Forces, founded in 1954. Japan does not call it a navy because of the postwar constitution. Often shortened to {海自|かいじ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother joined the Maritime Self-Defense Force.

examples.japanese: {海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{護衛艦|ごえいかん}→護衛艦：18332_goeikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A Maritime Self-Defense Force destroyer came into port.

examples.japanese: {海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The Maritime Self-Defense Force is said to have a custom of eating curry every Friday.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海自|かいじ}: the usual short form
- {海上自衛隊|かいじょうじえいたい}{員|いん}: a member of the JMSDF
- {海自|かいじ}⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧: the curry of the JMSDF, served on Fridays and now a regional dish in port towns

RELATED WORDS:
- {陸上自衛隊|りくじょうじえいたい} ({陸自|りくじ}): the Ground Self-Defense Force
